candidates.title: NIH launches initiative prioritizing human-based research technologies
candidates.note: Corrects approximate July chronology. Announcement includes planned ORIVA, reviewer-bias mitigation training, alternative-method expertise in study sections, funding/training/infrastructure expansion, and annual spending reporting.

candidates.title: NIH changes new funding-opportunity policy for animal-model systems
candidates.note: New NOFOs relating to animal-model systems must also support human-focused approaches; NIH says it will no longer issue NOFOs exclusively supporting animal models or prescribe the model type. This is implementation of the April commitment.

candidates.title: NIH clarifies that scientifically justified animal-model proposals remain eligible
candidates.note: Use primarily to prevent overstatement of the July 10 policy. NIH remains model-neutral at application level subject to scientific merit and justification.

candidates.title: NIH establishes $87M Standardized Organoid Modeling Center
candidates.note: Three-year contracts total $87M. Center targets reproducible standardized organoid protocols, open access, scalable production, and collaboration with FDA toward preclinical-testing standards.

candidates.title: First in-silico DDT LOI accepted into ISTAND
candidates.note: AI-driven digital liver model for DILI prediction. Accepted LOI is entry into qualification, not qualification.
Primary source verifies accepted-method-list expansion and a streamlined nomination pathway. Keep distinct from Aug. 27 documented use in specific regulatory decisions.

candidates.title: PMDA Early Consideration permits a WOE alternative to NHP DART testing
candidates.note: Direct PMDA Early Consideration states that when NHP is the only relevant species for a biopharmaceutical, an alternative WOE scheme can be used in place of NHP DART testing with appropriate scientific justification. Preserve status exactly: Early Consideration is nonbinding reference information/current thinking that may change, not final guidance.

candidates.title: PMDA Early Consideration rationalizes long-term monkey toxicity studies for monoclonal antibodies
candidates.note: PMDA states that retrospective evidence suggests three-month monkey studies can often provide sufficient information, identifies NAM data and clinical/class evidence as WOE inputs, and says the additional value of six-month monkey studies may be limited in specified circumstances. This is case-by-case Early Consideration, not binding final guidance.

candidates.title: MHRA publishes operational approach to medicines using non-animal methods
candidates.note: MHRA states that scientifically justified applications may omit animal studies when alternative evidence addresses safety; it does not support animal testing for drug substances that are not pharmacologically active in animals and gives biological/ATMP scenarios in which applications without animal studies may be acceptable. Preserve two temporal layers: this March 2026 assessment approach is current regulator policy, whereas the separate Module 4 pre-review mechanism is a future commitment to be established by end-2026.
